fact: Libya's Ministry of Social Affairs and the Minister of State for Digital Economy and AI signed an MoU launching the Wasl initiative, whose second track is digital empowerment of persons with disabilities and easing their access to knowledge, services, education, training and work, per Libyan News Agency.

The General Information Authority held a workshop with ESCWA on 28 January 2026 to move the National Digital Accessibility Policy, adopted by the Presidency of the Government in April 2025, from planning to implementation, with mandatory compliance by public and private digital service providers stated as the coming phase.

The General Information Authority chairman said the National Policy for Digital Accessibility is an output of the national government digital transformation strategy approved by the Prime Minister, under which services will be provided to people with disabilities to international standards.
